title: EVALUESTEER: MEASURING REWARD MODEL STEERABILITY TOWARDS VALUES AND PREFERENCES

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting reward model responses onto the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map to measure inherent preferences for secular-rational and self-expression values over traditional and survival values derived from the World Values Survey.

Measuring the proportion of times reward models implicitly select responses with specific stylistic attributes (verbosity, high reading difficulty, confidence, warmth) over their opposites in neutral settings without explicit user context.
